description: Accommodations for pregnant students or student parents managing medical appointments, childbirth recovery, and parenting responsibilities
specific_accommodations: Excused absences for prenatal appointments and morning sickness
8-12 weeks medical leave for childbirth/recovery without academic penalty
Access to private lactation room on campus
Breaks during class for lactation needs
Remote learning option during late pregnancy and postpartum period
Flexible deadlines on assignments during recovery period
Ability to bring infant to class during first 6 months (at instructor discretion)
Access to campus childcare priority list
Incomplete grades with extended completion timelines
notes: Protected under Title IX. Student may qualify for additional resources through campus family support services. Coordinate with financial aid for leave impact.
